findings.description: At 00:00.000 the unobstructed bowl contains two red, three green and three yellow balls. At 00:00.750 a third red ball is lifted between the hands while the original two red balls remain visible inside; this is especially clear at 00:01.000. Neither hand retrieves a ball from outside the bowl. Later, at 00:07.750 and 00:09.500, at least four distinct red balls are visible together during stirring, again without any visible addition. The red-ball inventory increases without a corresponding transfer or other visible cause.
